label: Sustaining versus originating causation of being, typed and connected to immensity and A2ab
summary: Follow-up to attempts 76bad0cb (immensity, next test 0) and dee1c25e (conservation and existential inertia). The tenseless CausesIn c x esse leaves open whether causing being originates or sustains it. New module TruthCore.Causality.SustainingCausation types the split over a TemporalHistory from one explicitly primitive relation BeingGiving.GivesAt (definition 158301bc: c exercises causation of x's being at moment t, effect-side index). Disambiguation 88a8fba7 CAUSE_OF_BEING: CAUSE_OF_BEING_1 OriginatesBeing (gives being at a first moment of presence; definition 142e451d) and CAUSE_OF_BEING_2 SustainsBeing (gives being at every moment of presence; definition ed47a5a7, the time-indexed image of the sourced per se conservation 56989bd0 without its dependence clause). They overlap (originatesOfSustains) and differ in what is required after the beginning. Connections, all verified conditional derivations, none establishing a premise: (i) presence step of the immensity sense bridge 8bf775e9: from the time-indexed contact principle c4661518 (after q.8 a.1), whatever CAUSE_OF_BEING_2 sustains all others is present to each whenever it is (c7de7537); with the sustaining reading of CausesIn (23e04ae5) and presence-in-act (140544c4), whatever is IMMENSE_2 is present by giving being to everything else whenever it is (9469ab62); with a narrowed sense bridge a3913182 (place, containment, measure, other modes of presence, immediacy) this gives 8bf775e9 itself by a single-application transcription (declared), so 8bf775e9 stays open until all its premises close; 8bf775e9 entails a3913182 (registered strength order, strictness unchecked). (ii) A2ab (71df1177) has two new routes: sustaining (16828262 every beginning concrete thing has a concrete sustaining cause, 1d4d9b13 sustainers are grounds, contact), valid in any preorder of times; and originating (b90c4dd1, 97150a94, contact, and 7a41ea33 convexity: no return after absence), and 800dc845 comparability of moments, an explicit linear-time premise; the originating premise requires a first moment of presence. Controls (779cd566): existential inertia (originator ceases, effect persists) satisfies the originating reading, contact and presence-in-act with an IMMENSE_2 being that is not present to all, and satisfies the whole originating route with A2ab; each premise of the presence route and of the sustaining A2ab route is needed in one interpretation, and convexity is needed for the originating route (the need of its other premises is not checked); intermittent presence breaks the originating route; all premises hold together nonvacuously. Objection audit (Substantive Objection Standard). Existential inertia is a SUBSTANTIVE objection to the sustaining reading 23e04ae5 and to 16828262. Target: those premises (and so the presence route to 8bf775e9 and the sustaining route to A2ab). Mechanism: a thing's being at m is explained by its being immediately before m, the absence of any factor causing its cessation, and the principle that a change occurs only if some factor induces it, so no concurrent giver of being is needed (Control part 1 is the typed shape). Independent justification: Schmid 2021 (SCHMID-INERTIA-REPLY-3-ARTICLE, paragraphs beginning 'For S to fail to exist at m' and 'Here, we seem to have', reread this round), who also accepts a PSR-like principle (paragraph 'And this discovery especially helps'; provisional analyst judgment of what that acceptance amounts to), so the rival is extrinsic explanation, not brute persistence. Relevance: the sustaining reading is exactly the step the presence route uses. Status: a rival framework with an argued mechanism, not an established counterexample; no case is shown in which a thing's being persists with no giver of being. Counter-argument attributed to Feser 2021 (FESER-INERTIA-REPLY-2021-ARTICLE, reread): constituents considered as such are only potentially the whole at t and past combination does not actualize their present combination (paragraph 'Rather, a critique'); the past is relevant but not by itself sufficient (paragraph 'Schmid does not attribute'); conservation is not annihilation and recreation (paragraph 'This makes it sound'). The first needs a concurrent-actualization premise (remaining in act is itself an actualization requiring an actual actualizer at the time); Schmid's principle (iii) grants a cause for change, so the dispute is whether remaining in being is a change-like actualization. Feser's circularity objection (paragraphs 'Now, an objection', 'I find this') targets an intrinsic persistence-power version of inertia and, as a provisional analyst judgment, does not reach Schmid's extrinsic no-change account. Motivation attributed to Aquinas, ST I q.104 a.1 co. and ad 4 (claims 40aefb2e, da9c82ed; passage reread): causes of becoming differ from causes of being; air is not lit even for a moment when the sun ceases; every creature is to God as air to sun because its esse is participated (essence is not existence); preservation is the continuation of the giving of esse, without motion or time. That comparison carries the sustaining reading only through the participated-esse premise and a further step that participated esse needs concurrent giving; it is motivation, not a derivation. No substantive objection was identified to the contact principle, presence-in-act or the narrowed bridge beyond what 8bf775e9 already carried; a gap-crossing (temporally distant) cause of being is a model possibility (Control part 2) with no independent justification on file. Where the dispute now sits: for immensity, exactly at 23e04ae5 (sustaining reading), whose warrant reduces to the concurrent-actualization step; for A2ab, not at sustaining causation, on the inclusive reading of GivesAt and on this formulation: the originating route needs only causes that an inertialist can grant when causing coming to be counts (on the strict esse-giving reading that is not shown), so the dispute over A2ab sits in contact (no giving across a temporal gap), convexity, comparability of moments, first moments of presence and originators-as-grounds; convexity and comparability enter only because b90c4dd1 ties the originating cause to the first moment of presence overall, and a premise tied to the first moment after the absence would need only contact and grounds (not formalized). Established: nothing; every new premise is OPEN and unattributed. Semantic-challenge repairs (2026-11-12). (a) Citation: q.104 a.1 co. says the builder causes the house's becoming and is not the direct cause of its being; definitions 142e451d and 158301bc now say so and distinguish a STRICT reading of GivesAt (esse-giving, CAUSING_AN_EFFECT_3 time-indexed; used by the sustaining sense and the immensity route) from an INCLUSIVE one (also causing coming to be, CAUSING_AN_EFFECT_1/CausesOrigin; the originating sense is stated for both, with no formal bridge to CausesOrigin). (b) Presence: History.IsAt is the same predicate in c4661518, 1335688a and spine premises A1-A3 and A2ab; one inclusive reading is adopted for all: actual in the history and bearing on t, by location at t (temporal things) or co-presence to t (a non-temporal agent). Check of A1-A3 against it (informal, not a formal check): A1 (present at some time implies exists in that history) is accepted, since co-presence is only ascribed to actual things. A3 (possibly, contingent concrete things absent at a moment and present later) concerns contingent things only and is unaffected. A2 (inert emptiness) is accepted, but its content shifts: a concrete-empty moment is one with nothing concrete located at or co-present to it, so A2's antecedent is rarer and its consequent harder to meet; the two do not order A2 by strength. Arrival A's conclusion then allows its necessary concrete individual to be a non-temporal being co-present to the empty-of-contingents moment, which a strictly locational reading would exclude. The GroundedBeginnings and SustainingCausation controls do not depend on the reading. (c) Sense machinery: 23e04ae5 is named in 88a8fba7 as the cross-term bridge CAUSING_AN_EFFECT_3 -> CAUSE_OF_BEING_2; recording CAUSING_AN_EFFECT_3 in the term senses of ffef89fd and 0681f64a was tried and rejected by bind-check (its sense declaration CausesAllInGenus does not occur in their theorems, which use an abstract CausesIn), so the bridge is named in prose only; folding the senses into CAUSING_AN_EFFECT_4/_5 of c3c01e92 is the remaining option. (d) Widening: 1d4d9b13 (and mildly 97150a94) widen A2ab's grounds relation; composed with the A2 derivation, A2c (bf18a0d0) must hold for the widened relation. Self-giving is not excluded by the type: a persistence-power inertialist could satisfy 16828262 with x as its own sustainer, which with 1d4d9b13 makes x its own ground, a self-loop that A2c then excludes if composed. (e) Unread lead, no evidential weight: corruptionist accounts of bodily resurrection (a human ceases at death and exists again) give intermittent existence within the case's own framework, against convexity 7a41ea33 unless restricted.
blocker: Not blocked. Next tests: (1) type the concurrent-actualization step (remaining in act as an actualization needing an actual actualizer at the time) against the existing act/potency vocabulary and test whether, with the participated-esse premises already on the case, it derives the sustaining reading 23e04ae5; that is where Aquinas/Feser and Schmid divide. (2) Type the dependence clause of 56989bd0 (the effect would not be at t without the giving) and compare it with Schmid's no-change counterfactuals. (3) For A2ab, assess the contact principle's temporal reading (no giving across a gap) and convexity against intermittent-existence and gappy-causation accounts; no rival with independent justification is on file. (4) Joint satisfiability of the full Dei Filius route through the narrowed bridge is unchecked.
